summary.one_liner: Grafana is an open-source platform for querying, visualizing, alerting on, and exploring metrics and logs from many data sources.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Grafana as a platform to query, visualize, alert on, and understand metrics wherever they are stored. It offers client-side graph panels with many visualization options, plus panel plugins for metrics and logs. Dashboards can use template variables that appear as dropdowns for reuse. Explore views support ad-hoc queries, drilldown, and side-by-side comparison of time ranges, queries, and data sources, and a logs explorer that keeps label filters when switching from metrics. Alert rules are defined visually and evaluated continuously, with notifications sent to systems such as Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, and OpsGenie. Queries can mix multiple data sources in one graph, selected per query, including custom data sources.
use_cases: set up alerts sent to Slack or PagerDuty
create reusable dashboards with template variables
explore and drill down into ad-hoc queries
how_to_run: Get Grafana (see the Get started guides referenced in the README)
Follow the installation guides on grafana.com/docs
Try the hosted demo at play.grafana.org
